name: Starwish Spawn
description: Raises the spawn chance of the account's STARWISH.
progression_note: Continues indefinitely with smaller increases until reaching +1%.

name: Disablelist Capacity
description: Adds a disablelist slot and lowers pool limits.
progression_note: Continues indefinitely with smaller reductions after the first tower.

name: Second Key Chance
description: Gives wished characters a chance to earn an additional key.
first_tower_effect: +10% chance for a second key on a wished character
progression_note: Falls to +5% after tower 2; after 100%, becomes third-key chance.

name: Sphere Button Reveal
description: Reveals hidden $oh buttons before choosing one.
progression_note: Caps at 9 revealed buttons, then becomes a sphere-doubling chance.

name: Sphere Income
description: Adds spheres from claims, $dailykakera, Bronze IV, and $rolls.
progression_note: Cycles through sources; later bonuses are reduced but continue indefinitely.

name: Maximum Kakera Power
description: Raises maximum base kakera reaction power.
progression_note: Continues indefinitely with smaller gains after the first tower and +1% after tower 75.

name: Kakera Reaction Cost
progression_note: Caps at -10% (30% reaction power); later floors add Red/Rainbow kakera.

name: Gold Key Income Cap
description: Raises the Gold Key kakera cap shown by $bku.
progression_note: Continues indefinitely; increases shrink after towers 11 and 21.

name: Light Kakera
description: Adds one random kakera inside Light Kakera.
progression_note: Caps at 13-14 rewards, then improves Chaos Kakera rarity.

name: Additional Rolls
progression_note: Caps at +10 rolls/hour, then raises Bronze IV and Silver IV kakera rewards.

name: Color Commands
description: Unlocks collection and profile color commands.
progression_note: Color unlocks cap at tower 2; later floors add Chaos Kakera.
